BOSTON--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 16, 2026--[BXP, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bxp.com%2F&esheet=54605535&newsitemid=20260916663114&lan=en-US&anchor=BXP%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=7e74b255ae8e89864f75d3a3e9146a6c) **(NYSE: BXP)** , the largest publicly traded developer, owner, and manager of premier workplaces in the United States, announced today that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.70 per share of common stock for the period July 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026, payable on October 30, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on September 30, 2026.


BXP, Inc. (NYSE: BXP) is the largest publicly traded developer, owner, and manager of premier workplaces in the United States, concentrated in six dynamic gateway markets - Boston, Los Angeles, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, and Washington, DC. BXP has delivered places that power progress for our clients and communities for more than 55 years. BXP is a fully integrated real estate company, organized as a real estate investment trust (REIT). As of June 30, 2026, including properties owned by unconsolidated joint ventures, BXP’s portfolio totaled 51.1 million square feet and 164 properties, including six properties under construction/redevelopment. For more information about BXP, please visit our[website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.bxp.com&esheet=54605535&newsitemid=20260916663114&lan=en-US&anchor=website&index=2&md5=d9575de54ec7e4b2371da4e30afa371a) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fbxp-inc%2F&esheet=54605535&newsitemid=20260916663114&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=3&md5=1b3d7d06936927cca6a41d35c32e2209) or[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fbxp_inc%2F&esheet=54605535&newsitemid=20260916663114&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=4&md5=17783de0c85c73c5525746eeb2398443) .
